1.web: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,
1.asv: But speak thou the things which befit the sound doctrine:

2.web: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in patience:
2.asv: that aged men be temperate, grave, sober-minded, sound in faith, in love, in patience:

3.web: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good;
3.asv: that aged women likewise be reverent in demeanor, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good;

4.web: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,
4.asv: that they may train the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,

5.web: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.
5.asv: to be sober-minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that the word of God be not blasphemed:

6.web: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded;
6.asv: the younger men likewise exhort to be sober-minded:

7.web: in all things showing yourself an example of good works; in your teaching showing integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,
7.asv: in all things showing thyself an ensample of good works; in thy doctrine showing uncorruptness, gravity,

8.web: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned; that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.
8.asv: sound speech, that cannot be condemned; that he that is of the contrary part may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say of us.

9.web: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters, and to be well-pleasing in all things; not contradicting;
9.asv: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters, and to be well-pleasing to them in all things; not gainsaying;

10.web: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.
10.asv: not purloining, but showing all good fidelity; that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Saviour in all things.

11.web: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,
11.asv: For the grace of God hath appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

12.web: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present world;
12.asv: instructing us, to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly and righteously and godly in this present world;

13.web: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ;
13.asv: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of the great God and our Saviour Jesus Christ;

14.web: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.
14.asv: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity, and purify unto himself a people for his own possession, zealous of good works.

15.web: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise you.
15.asv: These things speak and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no man despise thee.
